== Summary ==
The ''InQuest'' 38 (June 1998) "Force Playmat" insert: one sheet cut in half for a Dark Side (Darth Vader's Meditation Chamber) and a Light Side (Yoda's Hut) playmat. See [[SWCCG Memorabilia]].
